additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443321-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S2 170003362] Display Request CRM:02832000314
additional_info.body:
Dear Tanya,
First of all, thank you for your support in advance.
With the help of the Evosoft colleagues we have checked the charger remotely, and the colleagues could confirm that the data that should be visible on the screen is there.
I said to the customer, who is operating the chargers in Kosovo, to check the HDMI cable and if possible the power supply for the display.
The HDMI cable can be tested easily, so they will do it during the upcoming days, but I need info where they can check the power supply of the display.
If those 2 checks wont be successful to identify the source of the error, we might to start the warranty replacement process of the screen. For that we need the new screen, RMA documentation, then the Serbian colleagues from the CEE region will be able to send that back.
If you have any question, please contact me.
BR,
Szilard

additional_info.subject: ID0443321-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S2 170003362] Display Request CRM:00315002908
additional_info.body:
Hi Szilard, good morning.
Can you please explain better in detail what do you mean that the screen is not working and should be showing data? Do you have a photo of the screen?
Is it fully black or does it have a backlight?
Be careful that it's a Display Port cable, not a HDMI. For the Power supply measurements:
For this Display controller:
The screen appeared to have a backlight and as such I recommended to update the Display driver because as stated, the DP cable was already the new one.
After following the guide, when we got to the FW update, we could see that the LEDs on top were not light up, even though there were 24.6 V being applied to the controller and the firmware could not recognize the controller:
Initially I believed that it might be a voltage drop from the power supply to the controller and as such we disconnected the cable from pin 4c of F11-XD21 and reconnect it.
After this the voltage was 24.78 V and in the display terminal was 24.73 V:
We measured both sides of the connector to make sure it is not the connector that is faulty and concluded that the connector is not faulty.
If you measure the same exact things, then the PCB controller is faulty and needs replacement.
I send the RMA in attachment. Since this charger was made in Leipzig, I assume that you need to fill in the _Leipzig.pdf
I will send this ticket to the RC-HU queue please do the troubleshooting and repair if needed.
